newsitem.title: FINLAND: FOCUS - Merita Q1 profit surges.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - Merita Q1 profit surges.

text.p: Finland's largest banking group Merita Oy on Wednesday reported a much higher-than-expected increase in first quarter operating earnings and said full-year net earnings would improve on last year.

Merita's operating profit after credit losses surged to 934 million markka ($179.7 million) from 233 million in the year-ago period, boosted by a 584 million markka gain from the systematic downsizing of the group equity portfolio by 2.6 billion markka to 4.3 billion.
"The full-year result of the Merita group is expected to be distinctly better than in 1996," Merita said in a statement.
Merita has earlier said it expected the operating profit to improve on last year, so the outlook for better net earnings is in fact a more positive statement than its previous forecast, Merita said.
In 1996, Merita posted a 1.2 billion markka operating profit and its net profit was 1.72 billion markka.

Merita repeated that credit losses and costs would continue to fall, and most of the synergy benefits from the merger of Unitas and Kansallis-Osake-Pankki, which created the group in 1995, would be felt this year. ($ = 5.196 Finnish Markka)
